articleTitle: 50Gbps DDO-OFDM transmission after 80km without DCF based on an electro-absorption modulator
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: We proposed a method to realize 50Gbps Direct-Detection Optical Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (DDO-OFDM) after 80km SSMF transmission without dispersion compensating fiber based on selective subcarrier-filling, using a cost-effective electro-absorption Modulator.

articleTitle: Some considerations on the design of passive optical networks
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: Wavelength-agile hybrid WDM-TDM passive optical networks (PON) architecture, dual-mode ONT which enables user roaming between EPON and GPON, integration of PON, PON health monitoring (PHM) and home health monitoring (HHM), all these issues relate to design and applications of next generation PON are discussed.

articleTitle: Microwave photonic filter based on fractional delay lines
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: We report a new mcirowave photonic filter that offers continously tunable true time delays, based on the concept of fractional delay lines. Proof of concept experiments demosntrate a 10-tap microwave photonic fractional delay filter.

articleTitle: Polarization independent raman-assisted fiber optical parametric amplifiers
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a polarization independent Raman-assisted fiber optical parametric amplifier using depolarized Raman and parametric pumps. The polarization dependent gain fluctuation has been reduced from >;10 dB to less than 1 dB.

articleTitle: A new detection method for optical-frequency lightning signal
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: An optical-frequency lightning signal test system is introduced in this article. The wavelet transform can be used to remove the noise effectively. The simulation results show the wavelet transform works good and can be applied popularization.

articleTitle: Amplifierless 40-km SMF transmission for 100GE based on 4×25-Gbps optical duo-binary at 1550nm
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: By using optical duo-binary (ODB) modulation format, we have demonstrated 4×25-Gbps WDM transmission over 40- km SMFs at 1550nm without dispersion compensation and optical amplification, which could be a cost-effective candidate for 100GE applications.

articleTitle: Approaches for differentially-encoded photonic analog-to-digital conversion
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: This paper discusses techniques for photonic analog-to-digital conversion with differential encoding, which increases the equivalent number of bits. A new structure using dual-drive unbalanced Mach-Zehnder modulator is proposed.

articleTitle: Chromatic dispersion monitoring based on RF spectrum analysis and delay-tap sampling
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: In this paper, we summarize two chromatic dispersion monitoring techniques in high-speed transmission systems (>;40-Gbit/s). One method is based on optical filtering and RF spectrum analysis. The other one utilizes delay-tap sampling.

articleTitle: Flexible wavelength division multiplexing (FWDM) networks
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: Flexible wavelength division multiplexing improves resource utilization in optical networks. In this paper, we review the recent progresses in FWDM research on both the physical layer and the control plane aspects.

articleTitle: Iterative Wiener deconvolution method for optical power monitoring
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: An iterative Wiener deconvolution approach is proposed to monitor optical power from broadened spectrum. Experimental results show that it can accurately monitor the power in a mixed line rate network with 50-GHz spacing.

articleTitle: A novel method for improving phase coherence of optical pulse train with fiber nonlinear effects
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: A novel method for improving phase coherence of optical pulse train with wavelength conversion based on cross-phase modulation and four-wave mixing effects in the high nonlinear fiber is proposed. The approach is experimentally demonstrated and shows good performation to the MLFL pulse train.

articleTitle: Chaos synchronization and communication between two semiconductor lasers separated by a distance of 40 Km
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: A 40 Km fiber bidirectional chaotic communication system, composed of a driving chaotic semiconductor laser and twin semiconductor lasers, is proposed. We experimentally observe synchronization between the twin lasers driven by a chaotic signal, generated by the driving laser and after being transported in a pair of 20 Km single mode fibers. Based on the high-quality synchronization between the twin lasers, a bidirectional public cryptographic scheme is developed after introducing an additional optical path between the twin lasers as public message channel. Two GHz messages, encrypted into chaotic carriers, can be decrypted effectively in principle.

articleTitle: Fiber nonlinearities in coherent optial communication systems
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: We describe the impact of fiber nonlinear effects in coherent optical communication systems and discuss some nonlinearity compensation techniques.

articleTitle: Tunable and reconfigurable microwave photonic signal processors
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: Recent developments in microwave photonic signal processing featuring tunability and reconfigurablity are presented in the paper, with emphasis on the realisation of multi-tap microwave photonic filters, and programmable signal processing functions based on photonic approaches.

articleTitle: Ultra-fast measurement of passive optical components by optical channel estimation
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: In this paper, we extend the DSP-based optical channel estimation to measure their transfer functions of passive optical components. In experiment, we demonstrate sub-MHz resolution with a measurement speed bounded by the theoretical limit.

articleTitle: Performance optimization of next generation broadcasting network billing system based on EPON_EOC
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: The EPON_EOC network which is designed for Triple- play in China's broadcasting industry is analyzed. Besides, technical advantages of next generation billing system are indicated. Then, a performance optimization solution of this system is proposed, which is demonstrated to be feasible and effective in test results.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal four wavelength division multiplexing based on multimode interference theory
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: A two-dimensional photonic crystal (PC) four wavelength division multiplexing(WDM) based on multimode interference (MMI) theory is proposed, which realizes four wavelength divisions by cascading. The device is more compact and its performance parameters is improved.

articleTitle: Theoretical realization of a bend-resistant single-mode photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: A bend-resistant single-mode photonic crystal fiber (PCF) is presented based on the existence of a triangular core, and two cladding layers. Simulations show that it has a great ability against the bend-induced mode distortion and loss.

articleTitle: Ultra-fast phase recovery in semiconductor optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: We present results from theoretical analysis of the ultra-fast phase dynamics in semiconductor optical amplifiers in a numerical model. Furthermore, we explain the reason why a delay occurs between gain response and phase response.

articleTitle: Different output forms of vector solitons in fiber laser
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: Different output forms of mode-locked pulses, a single vector soliton pulse, unbound vector soliton bunches and soliton molecules are observed in fiber laser. The physical mechanisms of different forms of vector solitons owe to the different polarization filtering effects of polarization-dependent isolator.

articleTitle: The transmission spectrum of the phase-shifted grating influenced by refliction cofficient of fiber Bragg grating
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: According to phase properties of two grating elements in phase-shifted grating caused by reflection coefficient and standing wave condition of resonator, factors affecting transmission wavelength are discussed.

articleTitle: High stability microwave frequency distribution with optical fiber
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: We improve the phase stabilization of remote RF distribution based on opto-electronic delay locked-loop with a different wavelength backward signal. RMS jitter measured at remote end is under 730fs for a 10GHz, 100km transmission.

articleTitle: Investigation of modulation distortion in photonic UWB generation based on a phase modulator
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: The influence of large signal modulation on photonic UWB generation based on a phase modulator is investigated. The scheme for monocycle generation has better tolerance to modulation distortion than that of doublet generation.

articleTitle: A method to reduce the routing table size of server in electrical/optical data center network
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: This paper proposes a virtual hierarchical mesh network and efficient subnet agent selection method to reduce the routing table size of servers in server-only data center networks for better scalability of the network.

articleTitle: Photonic generation of chirp-free UWB signals with high tolerance to fiber dispersion
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: A technique to generate chirp-free UWB signal in the optical domain with extremely high tolerance to fiber dispersion based on a polarization modulator followed by an FBG notch filter is proposed and demonstrated.

articleTitle: Experimental research for phase DFIFT in the quantum communication system based on double M-Z interferometers
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: We present initially a novel real-time phase tracking method for drift phase, which is described by single-photon counts, and introduce an active compensating way for the periodic phase drift.

articleTitle: The design for methane gas sensor based on MCU
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: This paper proposed system design scheme, and introduced how to use a MCU to control every module. Then, we make the analysis and evaluation of the performance, have some summary and prospect for the key problems.

articleTitle: Two novel designs using raman amplifiers to extend the amplifier span of phase sensitive fiber optical parametric amplifiers
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: We proposed to use Raman amplifiers to extend the amplifier span of phase sensitive FOPAs. We numerically demonstrated two proposed schemes that can extend the amplifier span by about 25 km as well as reduce power consumption by 37%.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation for a hybrid switching strategy in data center
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: Optical interconnect techniques has been accepted to enable high bandwidth and low power dissipation in data center. We propose a hybrid switching strategy which improves the bandwidth utilization within a given power budget and maintains considerable performance.

articleTitle: Measured loss characteristics of 1 × 2 splitters for figuring double star topology
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: This paper clarifies the feasibility of MMF and POF for future networks by considering the measured loss characteristics of commercially available 1 × 2 splitters for the double star topology.

articleTitle: Indoor optical wireless integrated with white LED lighting: Perspective & challenge
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: Trends in integrating communication functionality to complement existing services by next-generation energy-saving white LED lighting are reviewed. Challenges at component and system level are discussed to enable visible light communication a practical service provision infrastructure.

articleTitle: All-optical wavelength muticasting
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: We review recent work on all-optical wavelength multicasting based on various techniques. We introduce two four-wave mixing based multicasting schemes; one is in highly nonlinear fiber loop mirror, the other is of reduced polarization sensitivity.

articleTitle: Slow/fast light in erbium-doped fibers based on cross gain modulation
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: We proposed and demonstrated the propagation of slow/fast light in erbium-doped fiber through gain cross modulation. We observed the ultraslow light with a group velocity of 6.1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> c and the superluminal propagation with a negative group velocity of -5.1 ×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>c.

articleTitle: MIMO transmission using SCM with modal diversity in multimode fiber systems
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: Transmission of 2 × 500 Mbps using Subcarrier Multiplexing (SCM) over 500 m graded-index multimode fiber combining modal diversity with direct detection and Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO) signal processing is demonstrated. Superior performance compared with Intensity Modulation Direct Detection (IM-DD) scheme is shown.

articleTitle: System evaluation of economic 16/32chs 1.25Gbps WDM-PON with self-seeded RSOA
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: We investigate a novel WDM-PON system by using self-seeded Reflective Semiconductor Optical Amplifier (RSOA) both in downstream and upstream. The transmission performance is evaluated and reported for the first time and meets carrier level requirements.

articleTitle: All optical sampling OFDM scheme with interleaved modulation formats for WDM PON
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: An all-optical sampling OFDM with interleaved modulation formats scheme for WDM PON application is proposed. It can flexibly adjust the modulation format and data rate due to different channel performance or different user requirements. This scheme has 80 Gb/s transmission data rate and can coexist with traditional WDM channel.

articleTitle: A chaotic Ultra-wideband (UWB) over fiber link
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: A chaotic Ultra-wideband (UWB) over fiber link with steerable and flatted power spectrum is demonstrated, which generates the photonic UWB signals using chaotic dynamics of the semiconductor laser with optical feedback.

articleTitle: Dimensioning fiber delay lines for header processing in asynchronous Optical Packet Switching networks
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: This paper aims to provide a concise yet comprehensive insights in dimensioning header processing FDLs. We study the effect of header processing on the packet drop probability, by taking into account different FDL size and packet arriving parameters. Our results show that header processing may incur un-negligible packet loss even before the packets are routed, especially when traffic load and burstiness are high.

articleTitle: Green optical channel layer design with minimum use of optical amplifiers and fibers
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: We plan for the optical channel layer to minimize the required numbers of lit fibers and turned-on optical amplifiers through a Mixed Integer Linear Programming (MILP) model and an efficient heuristic. Simulation studies indicate that the green communication-oriented effort can not only reduce the number of turned-on optical amplifiers but also the lit fibers.

articleTitle: Wavelength division multiplexing passive optical networks with broadcast capability and colorless ONUs
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: WDM-PON has become a promising solution to the next-generation access networks, owing to its broad bandwidth and upgradable flexibility. We experimentally demonstrated several WDM-PON architectures with broadcast capability and colorless optical networks units (ONU).

articleTitle: All-optical OOK-to-DPSK modulation format conversion using XPM in HNLF
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: We provide a comprehensive investigation of all-optical modulation format conversion from OOK-to-DPSK at 10 Gb/s using cross-phase modulation. We also present results on OOK-to-DPSK modulation format conversion with wavelength multicasting.

articleTitle: Narrow-linewidth external-cavity tunable lasers
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: This paper reports our recent work on narrow-linewidth tunable laser, which utilizes two etalons in the external cavity to obtain linewidth <; 100 kHz, tuning range ~ 40 nm, SMSR >; 60 dB and fiber-coupled output power >; 20 mW.

articleTitle: A centrally-controlled self-protected WDM-PON using N×N arrayed waveguide gratings
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: A centrally-controlled self-protected WDM-PON is proposed. It provides downstream 1:1 and upstream 1+1 protection, respectively. 2.5Gbps bidirectional transmissions under both working and protection modes are demonstrated. The protection switching time is about 2ms.

articleTitle: A fast switchable microwave milliwave signal generator based on a triple-wavelength fiber laser
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: A simple switchable microwave frequency generator based on a multi-wavelength fiber grating laser is proposed and demonstrated. Microwave signal of 10.4 GHz, 21.2 GHz, and 31.6 GHz can be obtained by simple adjustment of a polarization controller.

articleTitle: Desing a photonic crystal fiber surface plasma resonance sensor
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: A photonic-crystal-fiber surface-plasma-resonance sensor is investigated theoretically. Simulation indicates the resonance peak is extremely sensitive to fiber structure and golden film thickness, thus its shape and position can be tuned and optimized.

articleTitle: High precision laser ranging by combining phase method and multi-cycle pulse method
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: In this paper we propose a method of laser ranging by combining phase method and multi-cycle pulse method. We use the multi-cycle time to determine the distance, and use phase-shift to improve the measurement precision.

articleTitle: Graphene based, wide-band tunable mode-locked soliton fiber ring laser using intracavity birefringence-induced spectral filter
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: A graphene based, wide-band tunable soliton fiber laser exploiting the intracavity birefringence-induced spectral filter is demonstrated. By rotating the PC, the central wavelength of soliton pulse can be continuously tuned from 1531.5 to 1568.3 nm.

articleTitle: The application scheme of 40G and 100G Ethernet
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: The model structure of 40G/100G Ethernet and the key implementation technology Multi-Lane Distribution Mechanism (MLD) are thoroughly researched. Furthermore, three kinds of networking schemes based on 40G/100G Ethernet are proposed.

articleTitle: Application of lightpath data interchange in optical burst-switched networks
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: We show that using lightpath data interchange (LPI) is a practical way to provide optical burst switching (OBS) services in networks with slow optical switches such as wave-length-routed (WR) networks.

articleTitle: Optical crosstalk calculation technique for novel photonic network simulator
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: This paper describes the crosstalk calculation technique to enhance the simulator that enable future wavelength routing networks design including power budget, fiber dispersion, and ASE noise.

articleTitle: Direct-detection superchannel using optical OFDM
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: We will review the transmissions of a high-speed (>; 100Gb/s) direct-detection superchannel using optical OFDM over an all- EDFA-based standard-single-mode-fiber (SSMF) link.

articleTitle: Experimentally demonstration of subband-based optical networking on optical superchannel
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: We propose subband-based optical networking on optical OFDM or SCFDM superchannels. We experimentally demonstrate the feasibilities of switching and add-drop functionalities on individual subbands with a frequency spacing of 10-GHz.

articleTitle: High flexibility XML-based configuration system of fibre channel avionics environment
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: Fibre channel has been applied comprehensively to the new generation of avionics system. This paper presents the design and implementation of a high flexibility, XML-based configuration system of fibre channel avionics system, namely FC-X.

articleTitle: Novel optical techniques for lightpath tracing and monitoring in all-optical reconfigurable wavelength routing networks
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: A lightpath tracing scheme based on prime-number-encoded tags is proposed for all-optical reconfigurable wavelength routing networks. All traversed network nodes along the lightpath of a received optical packet can be identified at the destination node.

articleTitle: Tailoring optical chaos for communication and beyond
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: Optical chaos tailoring by a fiber Bragg grating that introduces dispersive optical feedback into a semiconductor laser is demonstrated numerically. The results have potentials in improving chaotic communication and chaotic ranging.

articleTitle: Frequency-doubling optoelectronic oscillator based on a polarization modulator
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: A frequency-doubling optoelectronic oscillator based on a polarization modulator without the use of an extra laser diode is introduced. The application of the OEO in microwave up- conversion is experimentally verified.

articleTitle: Ultra-wideband pulse generation based on cascaded semiconductor optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: A pair of polarity-reversed doublet pulses is generated based on a Mach-Zehnder modulator (MZM) and two cascaded semiconductor optical amplifiers (SOAs). The UWB polarity is controlled by adjusting the bias voltage of Mach-Zehnder modulator (MZM).

articleTitle: Mixed regenerator placement and routing and wavelength assignment for energy-efficient optical transport networks
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: We discuss network design algorithms to minimize the power consumption of an optical transport network with joined optimization of mixed regenerator placement and routing and wavelength assignment. The performance of the algorithms is investigated with simulations in various network topologies. Simulation results indicate that the algorithms can effectively reduce the number of O/E/O 3R regenerators, leading to less power consumption on signal regeneration and green network design.

articleTitle: Parametric tunable dispersion compensator for dynamic optical networking
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: We introduce parametric tunable dispersion compensator that has advantages of wide grid-less operating bandwidth and fast tuning response. The intrinsic two features are attributed to its tuning scheme based on FWM process in highly-nonlinear fiber with a low dispersion slope.

articleTitle: Instantaneous microwave frequency measurement using photonic techniques
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: This paper reviews several photonic techniques for instantaneous microwave frequency measurement recently proposed by us. Photonic measurement of frequency with improved performance and reduced complexity and cost is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Recent advances in hybrid access networks: From long-reach (LR) to short-reach (SR) systems
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: We discuss the recent progress in the research of hybrid WDM-TDM access networks. Different system design issues of the long-reach (LR) passive-optical-network (PON) and the short-reach (SR) wireless fiber-to-the-antenna (FTTA) system will be discussed.

articleTitle: [Table of contents]
publicationTitle: 10th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN 2011)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: optical fibre network; wavelength division multiplexing; optical fibre amplifier; optical switches; optical fibre laser; optical modulation; OFDM transmission; radio-over-fibre; and optical fibre channel.
